The '''Kleeva system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. It contained the massive [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Kleeva]], which was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by at least three [[Moon/Legends|moons]], including [[Boonda's Moon]] and [[Vultee-Pietsch]].
